summary: Give large Bitcoin caches a bounded and observable graceful shutdown phase
details: Bitcoin Core is explicitly stopped before its Compose project is removed, with UTC start, heartbeat, completion, elapsed-time, exit-code, and OOM observations.
The default stop grace period is increased from 10 to 30 minutes so the temporary 20 GiB IBD cache can flush on slower storage before Docker resorts to a forced kill.
A non-OOM exit code 137 is reported as a possible stop-timeout kill while bind-mounted Bitcoin data remains preserved.
DEGRADED guidance now distinguishes the manual usdb-node recovery gate from Docker's existing container restart policy.
